summary.text: Cindy Holscher is a Democratic state senator from Overland Park, first elected to the Senate in 2020 after serving in the Kansas House. Her campaign centers on school funding, health care access (she cites her votes to expand Medicaid), cutting property taxes by lowering assessment rates, a pause on new data centers, and legalizing cannabis.

paragraphs.text: Raised on a farm; first-generation college graduate with degrees in journalism and political science from the University of Missouri (1992); worked for Sprint and as a substitute teacher.
Served in the Kansas House for four years, co-founding the Women's Bipartisan Caucus, before winning election to the Kansas Senate in 2020.
